<script type="text/javascript">
(() => {
  const id = 'lav24-native-dialog-fit';
  if (document.getElementById(id)) return;

  const style = document.createElement('style');
  style.id = id;
  style.textContent = '.ihdialog > .dialog[data-lav24-fit]{flex:none;zoom:var(--lav24-dialog-scale)}'
    + '.ihdialog > .dialog [style*="--lav24-dialog-journal"],.ihdialog > .dialog [style*="--lav24-dialog-journal"] *{overscroll-behavior:contain}';
  document.head.appendChild(style);

  let frame = 0;
  function fitDialogs() {
    frame = 0;
    const viewport = document.documentElement;
    for (const dialog of document.querySelectorAll('.ihdialog > .dialog:has(> [style*="--lav24-paper"])')) {
      const width = parseFloat(dialog.style.width);
      const height = parseFloat(dialog.style.height);
      if (!(width > 0 && height > 0 && viewport.clientWidth > 24 && viewport.clientHeight > 24)) continue;
      const scale = Math.min(1, (viewport.clientWidth - 24) / width, (viewport.clientHeight - 24) / height);
      if (scale < 1) {
        dialog.style.setProperty('--lav24-dialog-scale', String(scale));
        dialog.setAttribute('data-lav24-fit', '');
      } else {
        dialog.style.removeProperty('--lav24-dialog-scale');
        dialog.removeAttribute('data-lav24-fit');
      }
    }
  }

  function schedule() {
    if (!frame) frame = requestAnimationFrame(fitDialogs);
  }

  new MutationObserver(schedule).observe(document.body, {childList: true, subtree: true});
  window.addEventListener('resize', schedule, {passive: true});
  schedule();
})();
</script>
